name: request_user_job
description: Delegate a task to the human user. The turn pauses until the user completes the task and reports back through an interactive card. Use it when a step needs a real-world action, credentials, a decision, or information only the human can provide. Pass a clear `description` of what to do; the returned text is the user's free-form report. A `job_id` is included so you can recall it later with job_output / job_list.

description.description: What the user should do. Be specific and self-contained; the user will not see the surrounding conversation.

title.description: Optional short heading for the task card shown to the user.

prompt: request_user_job: delegate a real-world task to the human user. The turn pauses until the user completes it and submits a free-text report via the card. Use it only when a step needs an action, credentials, a decision, or information only the human can provide. Pass a clear `description`. The result is the user's report; the `job_id` in it lets you recall the job later with job_output / job_list.
